## Safety Boundaries
- Do not overwrite user changes or generated instruction files unless the file contains the repo-to-agents marker or the user explicitly asks.

## Contribution Workflow
- Start from a clean branch and inspect existing issues or README guidance before changing behavior.
- Implement the smallest coherent change, then update tests, docs, and examples that describe the changed behavior.
- Before opening a PR, run `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`.
- In PR descriptions, summarize behavior changes, verification performed, and any follow-up risks.
